jdk.xml.enableExtensionFunctions.description: Boolean value determining whether XSLT and XPath extension functions are allowed.

jdk.xml.overrideDefaultParser.description: Boolean value determining whether a third party implementation can override the default JDK parser.

jdk.xml.jdkcatalog.resolve.description: Setting for JDK default CatalogResolver behavior when unable to resolve an external reference. Options: continue, ignore, strict.

jdk.xml.dtd.support.description: Setting for DTD processing. Options: deny, ignore, allow.

jdk.xml.entityExpansionLimit.description: Integer limit for the number of entity expansions.

jdk.xml.totalEntitySizeLimit.description: Integer limit for the total size of all entities (general and parameter).

jdk.xml.maxGeneralEntitySizeLimit.description: Integer limit for the maximum size of any general entities.

jdk.xml.maxParameterEntitySizeLimit.description: Integer limit for the maximum size of any parameter entities.

jdk.xml.entityReplacementLimit.description: Integer limit for the total number of nodes in all entity references.

jdk.xml.elementAttributeLimit.description: Integer limit for the number of attributes an element can have.

jdk.xml.maxOccurLimit.description: Integer limit for the number of content model nodes for W3C XML Schema maxOccurs.

jdk.xml.maxElementDepth.description: Integer limit for the maximum element depth.

jdk.xml.maxXMLNameLimit.description: Integer limit for the maximum size of XML names.

jdk.xml.xpathExprGrpLimit.description: Integer limit for the number of groups an XPath expression can contain.

jdk.xml.xpathExprOpLimit.description: Integer limit for the number of operators an XPath expression can contain.

jdk.xml.xpathTotalOpLimit.description: Integer limit for the total number of XPath operators in an XSL Stylesheet.
